Google's own Bangladesh-billed direct price for the identical plan is BDT 2,500/month — i.e. SaveOnSub's approved resale price is ~35.6% MORE EXPENSIVE than buying Google AI Pro directly from Google in BDT. The USD-anchor formula appears to be the wrong reference for this SKU because Google already bills Bangladesh in local currency below the formula's landed-cost assumption. This is a pre-existing Pricing V2 defect, not something introduced by this build pass. Recommend: CEO decides between (a) HOLD google-ai-pro as price-on-request pending a service-fee-only model, or (b) a new CEO-approved BDT price that is honestly positioned as a service/assistance fee rather than implying a discount versus Google's own price. Not changed in this pass — flagged for explicit CEO decision only.
